Title: Confirm scope and instructor feedback
Acceptance criteria: Use-case ID mapping; feedback recorded; assumptions reviewed; no invented feedback.

Title: Plan two Sprints and prioritize backlog
Acceptance criteria: Real dates, goals, estimates, owners and acceptance criteria in the existing Project.

Title: Review design and create Visual Paradigm models
Acceptance criteria: UC04 and UC13 sequence diagrams; focused class model and architecture; native .vpp opens.

Title: Implement and review shared inventory and Add Goods
Acceptance criteria: New/existing items; validation; one movement per addition; failure leaves state unchanged.

Title: Implement and review sale drafting and pricing Strategy
Acceptance criteria: Multiple items; repeated-item aggregation; quantity validation; configurable discount and tax; price snapshot.

Title: Review constraints and exactly three NFRs
Acceptance criteria: Four or more classified constraints; three measurable NFRs; source and verification; scope distinction.

Title: Conduct Sprint 1 review and retrospective
Acceptance criteria: Actual date/attendees; demo evidence; accepted/incomplete tasks; improvement owner and target date.

Title: Review sale commit cancellation and receipt Builder
Acceptance criteria: Confirm exactly once; recheck stock; no partial changes; cancelled sale recorded; receipt built and displayed.

Title: Validate JavaFX usability and shared inventory on Windows
Acceptance criteria: Both workflows on Windows 11; input messages; navigation; screenshot evidence and machine details.

Title: Execute Route A test cases and evaluate results
Acceptance criteria: At least 3 cases per use case; normal/alternative paths; expected/actual/pass-fail; raw execution evidence.

Title: Verify two pattern categories UML and live use
Acceptance criteria: Strategy behavioral and Builder creational; justify against alternatives; UML/code/demo agree.

Title: Integrate Word report and reconcile all models
Acceptance criteria: Latest native VP exports replace provisional diagrams; code and tests match; evidence captions accurate.

Title: Conduct Sprint 2 review and retrospective
Acceptance criteria: Actual review and retro; show Sprint 1 improvement applied; individual contribution links.

Title: Verify final submission package and links
Acceptance criteria: main/Milestone-2 complete; repository/project/milestone/final commit links; four separate peer evaluations.
